# Wakilz AI Voice Agent

> Wakilz is an AI voice agent platform built for real estate. It automates 24/7 inbound phone lead qualification, instant CRM synchronization, and site visit appointment scheduling in English, Hindi, and Telugu with sub-second latency.

## Core Capabilities
- [AI Real Estate ISA](https://wakilz.com/ai-isa-real-estate): 24/7 automated qualification of inbound phone callers and ad leads.
- [Multilingual Real Estate Voice Agent](https://wakilz.com/multilingual-voice-agent): Fluent voice interactions across English, Hindi, and Telugu with native regional accents.
- [Luxury Real Estate Voice Agent](https://wakilz.com/ai-voice-agent-luxury-real-estate): High-touch qualification for luxury developments and HNIs.
- [Wakilz vs Human ISA](https://wakilz.com/wakilz-vs-human-isa): Performance, response speed under 30 seconds, and ROI comparison.
- [Conversations & Call Logs](https://wakilz.com/conversations): Real call audio recordings, transcripts, and lead intent extraction.

## Solutions & Platform
- [Live Interactive Portal](https://wakilz.com/): Real-time browser voice call demo powered by WebRTC and Google Cloud Run voice engine.
- [CRM Integrations](https://wakilz.com/): Instant webhooks and two-way sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, LeadSquared, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp.
